newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux says '96 Asian sales up 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux says '96 Asian sales up 15 pct.

text.p: Swedish appliance maker Electrolux AB said on Tuesday sales for 1996 in Asia are estimated to rise by 15 percent and not by 80 percent as earlier reported.

"The increase in sales for Electrolux in Asia for the full year of 1996 is estimated to be approximately 15 percent, instead of 80 percent which was incorrectly reported at a press conference in Singapore earlier today," Electrolux said.
Electrolux said in 1994 it set a goal to double its sales outside western Europe and North America in the next three to five years.
"This goal, that includes Asia, Latin America and eastern Europe, will be reached at the end of 1996, calculated on an annual basis," it said in a statement.
Electrolux's Stefan Schlyter said earlier in Singapore that Electrolux would achieve $1.8 billion in sales in 1996 compared to 1995's $1.0 billion.
